name: DELETE /api/admin/accounts/:id/trial - Cancel a trial early
description: Ends an active trial immediately and reverts the account to the free plan. MUTATING, so the Authorization header carries the step-up token — auth is orthogonal to HTTP method, DELETE needs it too. Runs after the trial-grant test, which creates the trial this cancels.

errorCases.when: The :id path parameter is not a valid UUID

errorCases.message: Step-up verification required for this action
errorCases.when: The Authorization header carries a plain admin session token rather than an elevated step-up token

errorCases.message: This account has no active trial
